title: Ergodic Theorems for Random Walks in Random Environments
summary: We study the Ergodic Properties of Random Walks in stationary ergodic environments without uniform ellipticity under a minimal assumption. There are two main components in our work. The first step is to adopt the arguments of Lawler to first prove a uniqueness principle. We use a more general definition of environments using~\textit{Environment Functions}. As a corollary, we can deduce an invariance principle under these assumptions for balanced environments under some assumptions.
